name: Aurans
description: Valley settlers who measure trust in shared meals, repaired fences, and remembered birthdays. They are warm, practical, and terrifyingly organized when a festival is at stake.
assetTheme: Warm textiles, practical tools, family crests, bread/festival iconography, civic uniforms.

name: Mireborn
description: Wetland lineages who treat memory as a living ecosystem. They mourn beautifully, forgive slowly, and know which herbs help the dead speak softly.
assetTheme: Reflective glass jewelry, reed houses, mourning veils, memory lanterns, herbal masks.

name: Ashkin
description: Volcanic border people raised around watchfires, oath songs, and ironwork. They are fierce without being careless, and their rituals make even silence feel armed.
assetTheme: Dark metal armor, red ceramic charms, ember tattoos, basalt architecture.

name: Coastfolk
description: Maritime families of traders, fishers, sailors, cooks, and dock poets. They welcome strangers quickly, haggle theatrically, and celebrate as if tomorrow's tide is not guaranteed.
assetTheme: Sails, shell ornaments, blue-green dyes, fish markets, rope bridges, shipboard shrines.

name: Highroot Clans
description: Canopy dwellers who read rain, bark, bird calls, and animal moods as civic advice. They move patiently because the forest has already survived every empire.
assetTheme: Layered leaf cloaks, carved wood, animal motifs, vertical village assets.

name: North Archive Houses
description: Snow scholars and archive families who keep ancestral law under cold lamps. They are analytical, formal, and quietly sentimental about names that survived winter.
assetTheme: Pale stone, fur-lined robes, runic ledgers, cold-light lamps, archive vaults.
